summary_en: VVT/VCT actuator circuit on bank 1. Confirm oil level/condition and the connector before assuming the solenoid is failed.
common_causes: Stuck or failed VVT solenoid (verify command vs actual)

summary_en: CKP and CMP signals do not agree. Timing chain/belt or a sensor correlation issue — educational only, not a parts order.
common_causes: Stretched timing chain or jumped tooth (shop if engine noise)
safety_notes: A rattling engine or no-start after this code is a stop-and-shop concern.

summary_en: Mass air flow signal is low. Intake leaks after the MAF and a dirty element are common educational checks.
Manifold pressure reading is out of range. Vacuum leaks and live MAP vs RPM should be confirmed first.
Engine coolant temperature signal is low. Confirm coolant level and the sensor connector — not an automatic thermostat replacement.
common_causes: ECT connector or short to ground

summary_en: Engine coolant temperature signal is high. Open circuit and connector checks come before parts.

title_en: O2 Sensor Circuit Low Voltage (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
summary_en: Upstream O2/AFR voltage is low. Exhaust leaks before the sensor and connector condition are educational first checks.

title_en: O2 Sensor Circuit Slow Response (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
summary_en: Upstream O2 response is slow. Aging sensor or exhaust leaks — confirm with live data, not a converter verdict.

title_en: O2 Sensor Circuit No Activity (Bank 1 Sensor 1)
summary_en: Upstream O2 shows no activity. Heater circuit and connector are educational checks before replacement.

title_en: O2 Sensor Circuit Low Voltage (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
summary_en: Downstream O2 voltage is low. Do not assume the catalytic converter has failed from this code alone.
Cylinder 1 injector circuit. Confirm connector, fuse/power, and misfire correlation — not a PCM parts order.
Knock sensor circuit high. Connector and harness routing are educational checks; engine knock in traffic is a shop concern.
CMP signal is out of expected range. Correlation with crank sensor and connector checks come first.
Ignition coil B circuit. Swap/observe only if the manual allows; do not invent coil part numbers.
EGR flow is not as expected. Carbon, passages, and the valve circuit are educational checks — not a converter diagnosis.
EVAP purge flow is incorrect. Cap, hoses, and purge solenoid are educational checks.
EVAP purge valve circuit. Connector and command vs click tests are educational — not a tank replacement.

title_en: Fuel Level Sensor Circuit High Input
summary_en: Fuel level signal is high. Gauge cluster vs sender circuit — educational, not a pump replacement.
Idle speed control is out of range. Vacuum leaks and throttle-body carbon (observe) before parts.
Gear-range/PRNDL circuit. Confirm shifter position sensor and connector — unexpected gear display is a shop concern if the vehicle moves wrongly.
safety_notes: If displayed gear does not match actual movement, stop driving and use a qualified shop.

title_en: Torque Converter Clutch Circuit Performance/Stuck Off
summary_en: TCC performance. Fluid condition and command vs slip are educational; internal trans work is shop-level.

title_en: Post Catalyst Fuel Trim Too Lean (Bank 1)
summary_en: Downstream fuel trim is lean. Exhaust leaks and O2 data first — do not treat this as a confirmed converter failure.
common_causes: Fuel trim from an upstream issue

title_en: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch A/B Voltage Correlation
summary_en: Throttle or pedal position sensors disagree. Unexpected throttle response is a stop-driving concern until verified.
common_causes: Electronic throttle body (shop if surge/idle will not return)
safety_notes: If the vehicle surges or will not return to idle, stop driving.

title_en: Throttle/Pedal Position Sensor/Switch D/E Voltage Correlation
summary_en: Pedal position sensors disagree. Treat unexpected acceleration as a stop-driving concern.
safety_notes: Unexpected throttle response: stop driving until verified.

title_en: O2 Sensor Signal Biased/Stuck Lean (Bank 1 Sensor 2)
summary_en: Downstream O2 looks stuck lean. Exhaust leaks and connector checks first; not a converter parts order.
Hybrid/EV battery pack performance code. High-voltage work is not DIY. Record the code and use a qualified hybrid shop or dealer — this title is SAE wording, not a command to replace the pack today.
safety_notes: Do not open orange-cable HV packs. Qualified high-voltage technician only.

summary_en: CAN/network bus off. Battery voltage and grounds first. Lost comms can disable ABS/SRS messages until verified.
safety_notes: ABS or other modules may be unavailable — allow extra stopping distance until scanned.

title_en: Lost Communication With Body Control Module
summary_en: Lost BCM comms. Power/grounds and network integrity come before module replacement.

title_en: Left Front Wheel Speed Sensor Circuit Range/Performance
summary_en: LF wheel-speed performance. Harness and tone ring are educational checks. ABS may be limited.
safety_notes: ABS or traction control may be limited until verified.
